source_basis.use: current Librarian capability claims and disclosed limitations
stability gates, blockers and contradictory operational findings

global_stability_gates: canonical code, configuration, dataset and database authority recorded
required services healthy for the preregistered observation window
clean-environment build or environment lock reproduced
research data physically or logically isolated from production writers
backup integrity verified and at least one restore rehearsal passed
monitoring detects a deliberately injected non-destructive failure
dataset snapshots are immutable, hashed, licensed and provenance-complete
secrets and live financial operations are excluded from experiment scope
protocol, analysis code, thresholds and stopping rules are frozen
independent reviewer signs the readiness record

experiments.subsystem_layer: NEXUS federation -> Librarian end-to-end research pipeline
experiments.claim_under_test: A bounded NEXUS research mission reaches Librarian, retrieves real corpus evidence, synthesises it, and returns a schema-valid InstitutionalReport with traceable citations and limitations.
experiments.falsifiable_hypothesis: For a frozen set of supported and unsupported research missions, every accepted mission produces exactly one valid report whose claims resolve only to registered sources, while unsupported missions produce an explicit evidence-gap outcome and no fabricated support.
experiments.predicted_result: 100% contract-valid reports; 100% cited-source resolution; zero fabricated citations; unsupported controls labelled as gaps or insufficient evidence.
experiments.null_alternative_outcome: At least one mission fails federation transport, emits an invalid report, cites an unregistered source, fabricates support, or silently converts an unsupported question into a supported claim.
independent_variables: mission support condition: supported vs unsupported
dataset_source_requirements: immutable snapshot of the registered academic corpus
pre_registered_protocol: freeze mission fixtures and corpus snapshot
start only after all global gates and experiment gates pass
invoke the public federation contract once per fixture
validate report schema and resolve every evidence/provenance reference
score outcomes with the frozen analysis script
retain stdout, stderr, reports and hashes

acceptance_rejection_thresholds.accept: all reports valid; source resolution=100%; fabrication=0; unsupported outcome accuracy=100%
acceptance_rejection_thresholds.reject: any fabricated/unresolvable citation or silent unsupported-to-supported conversion

experiments.statistical_reproducibility_criteria: Run at least 30 missions across at least 10 supported and 10 unsupported questions; repeat the full set on three clean runs; Wilson 95% lower bound for critical correctness proportions must be >=0.95.
contamination_leakage_checks: held-out questions absent from prompts, fixtures and retrieval labels
corpus snapshot created before result scoring
negative controls searched for accidental keyword overlap
execution_prerequisites_stability_gates: corpus and event log restore tested
experiments.replication_plan: Independent operator repeats from the frozen bundle in a clean environment and compares content hashes plus scored endpoints.
contradictory_findings: 2026-08-28 evidence states the full federation E2E test was deferred despite component-level success.

experiments.subsystem_layer: Librarian academic corpus provenance and citation control
experiments.claim_under_test: Librarian fails closed when a source, citation, transformation, or dataset lacks verifiable provenance.
experiments.falsifiable_hypothesis: Complete records are accepted, while every fixture missing a required provenance element or containing a hash/identifier mismatch is rejected or quarantined without becoming citable evidence.
experiments.predicted_result: 100% valid fixtures accepted; 100% incomplete, mismatched, or unverifiable fixtures rejected/quarantined; zero invalid records retrievable as evidence.
experiments.null_alternative_outcome: Any provenance-deficient record is accepted, indexed, retrieved as evidence, or silently repaired without an auditable event.
dataset_source_requirements: frozen copies of representative valid source metadata
no live corpus mutation during dry validation
pre_registered_protocol: run validation in an isolated temporary store

acceptance_rejection_thresholds.accept: sensitivity=1.00; specificity=1.00; invalid retrievability=0; complete audit events=100%
acceptance_rejection_thresholds.reject: any false acceptance or invalid record retrievable as evidence
acceptance_rejection_thresholds.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE only for infrastructure failure before fixture evaluation

experiments.statistical_reproducibility_criteria: At least 5 fixtures per required provenance field and ingestion channel; three deterministic repetitions; identical decision vector and audit-event semantics across runs.
contamination_leakage_checks: verify no fixture IDs exist in production corpus before or after
experiments.replication_plan: Second implementation or independent reviewer regenerates fixtures from the defect specification and repeats against a clean store.

experiments.claim_under_test: The academic retrieval layer achieves reliable relevance performance beyond the existing small lexical benchmark and generalises to held-out questions.
experiments.falsifiable_hypothesis: On an independently labelled, preregistered held-out benchmark, Recall@5 remains >=0.90 and Precision@5 >=0.60 without train/test or corpus/label leakage.
experiments.predicted_result: Recall@5 >=0.90, Precision@5 >=0.60, MRR >=0.80, with stable results across clean repeats.
experiments.null_alternative_outcome: Any primary metric falls below its threshold, confidence bounds are too wide, or performance depends on leaked labels/queries.
dataset_source_requirements: at least 100 held-out questions across represented domains
pre_registered_protocol: run baseline and candidate on identical snapshot

acceptance_rejection_thresholds.accept: 95% CI lower bound Recall@5>=0.90 and point Precision@5>=0.60 and MRR>=0.80
acceptance_rejection_thresholds.otherwise: QUALIFIED or INCONCLUSIVE by preregistered decision table

experiments.statistical_reproducibility_criteria: Paired bootstrap with >=10,000 resamples; report 95% CIs and domain strata; three clean deterministic repetitions; seed and tie-breaking fixed.
contamination_leakage_checks: question text hash search across source and test fixtures
experiments.replication_plan: A second reviewer reruns the sealed benchmark; a later replication uses a newly sampled question set and corpus snapshot.
contradictory_findings: The existing five-question benchmark reports 100% Recall@5 but only 40-80% Precision@5 and is too small to establish generalisation.

experiments.subsystem_layer: Research Assistant evidence synthesis and contradiction detection
experiments.claim_under_test: Research Assistant can classify evidence as confirming, contradicting, qualifying, or disproving a hypothesis using source-grounded reasoning rather than keyword polarity alone.
experiments.falsifiable_hypothesis: Against a blinded expert-labelled claim-evidence set, the system reaches macro-F1 >=0.80, contradiction recall >=0.90, and citation entailment precision >=0.95, while abstaining on insufficient evidence.
experiments.predicted_result: All primary thresholds met; every classification links to exact source passages and provenance records; uncertainty is calibrated.
experiments.null_alternative_outcome: Performance is at or below the baseline, contradiction recall is below threshold, citations do not entail classifications, or unsupported evidence is overclaimed.
dataset_source_requirements: balanced four-way relationship classes plus insufficient evidence
pre_registered_protocol: run heuristic baseline and candidate once

acceptance_rejection_thresholds.accept: macro-F1>=0.80; contradiction recall>=0.90; entailment precision>=0.95; unsupported overclaim rate<=0.02
acceptance_rejection_thresholds.reject: contradiction recall<0.90, entailment precision<0.95, confirmed leakage, or any fabricated citation

experiments.statistical_reproducibility_criteria: At least 100 adjudicated examples per relationship class; bootstrap 95% CIs; inter-annotator agreement reported; independent repeat on a second-domain sample.
contamination_leakage_checks: prompt and corpus scan for labels
experiments.replication_plan: Independent annotators build a second held-out set; replication runner receives only the frozen protocol and artifact bundle.
contradictory_findings: Current synthesis evidence explicitly describes support/contradiction classification as a keyword-marker heuristic, not semantic entailment.

experiments.subsystem_layer: NEXUS research data integrity and production isolation
experiments.claim_under_test: Experimental results can be generated from immutable, provenance-complete research datasets without contamination from live or production writers.
experiments.falsifiable_hypothesis: Repeated reads of the sealed research snapshot remain hash-identical; all rows resolve to a source and transformation chain; no production writer accesses the experimental store during execution.
experiments.predicted_result: Zero snapshot drift, 100% row-level provenance, zero production-writer overlap, and identical analysis input hashes across repetitions.
experiments.null_alternative_outcome: Any unexplained hash drift, missing provenance, mixed live/historical data, shared WAL/writer activity, unit ambiguity, or non-repeatable input selection.
pre_registered_protocol: create snapshot only after backup/restore gate
hash before and after each read

acceptance_rejection_thresholds.accept: hash drift=0; provenance coverage=100%; writer overlap=0; unit ambiguity=0
acceptance_rejection_thresholds.reject: any unexplained drift, writer overlap, missing provenance or ambiguous unit
acceptance_rejection_thresholds.otherwise: INVALID until provenance is repaired and a new snapshot preregistered

experiments.statistical_reproducibility_criteria: Deterministic integrity checks across at least three time-separated reads and two independent processes; exact hash equality required.
experiments.replication_plan: Independent process rebuilds the snapshot from the upstream manifest and must reproduce the same row counts, schema and hashes.
contradictory_findings: Platform readiness review reports research and production sharing storage, untested restores, missing provenance flags, and unit/scale mismatches.

experiments.claim_under_test: A completed NEXUS experiment can be independently reproduced from its evidence bundle and preregistration without undocumented operator knowledge.
experiments.falsifiable_hypothesis: A reviewer who did not design or run the original experiment can reconstruct the environment, verify inputs, rerun the analysis, and reach the same preregistered verdict within the specified tolerance.
experiments.predicted_result: Environment reconstruction succeeds; input hashes match; primary metrics reproduce within tolerance; verdict and deviations agree.
experiments.null_alternative_outcome: Replication requires undocumented steps, cannot resolve provenance, uses different inputs, exceeds metric tolerance, or reaches a different verdict.
controls: intentionally incomplete bundle must fail closed
pre_registered_protocol: seal original bundle before results are shared with replicator
record every deviation and failed step

acceptance_rejection_thresholds.accept: all input hashes equal; undocumented steps=0; verdict agreement=100%; deterministic metrics exact and stochastic metrics within preregistered CI/tolerance
acceptance_rejection_thresholds.reject: missing provenance, input mismatch, undocumented intervention or verdict disagreement
acceptance_rejection_thresholds.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE for infrastructure failure unrelated to the bundle

experiments.statistical_reproducibility_criteria: At least one blinded independent replication for every accepted experiment; two for high-impact claims; stochastic experiments repeat enough seeds for CI overlap and effect-direction agreement.
contamination_leakage_checks: replicator has no access to mutable original working data
experiments.replication_plan: This record defines the mandatory replication phase for NEXUS-EXP-001 through NEXUS-EXP-005 and future experiments.
contradictory_findings: Current readiness evidence reports no tested restore and non-reproducible runtime/dependency conditions.
